title: Chapter 6263: Fire Can Turn Into Ashes?

Chapter 6263: Fire Can Turn Into Ashes?

Chapter 6263: Fire Can Turn Into Ashes?

"Boom!" Crimson Cauldron Emperor erupted like millions of volcanoes. Flames gushed out and ravaged the battlefield.

He gathered flames worldwide to his cauldron and refined them into something devastating. Rumor has it that each wave was stronger than the previous, dozens of times or even a hundred times.

"Buzz." Forests and the ground above the crater turned into flowing lava.

"Back, back up more!" Experts retreated with haste.

"Burn the sky!" He roared and the sky turned into an ocean of lava gushing toward Li Qiye.

Any emperor of a similar cultivation couldn't stop the overbearing technique. However, Li Qiye gathered more flames from the tree and tossed them up.

The wisps could burn flames and laws of the fire affinity. Words couldn't describe its consuming potential, shifting the ocean into ashes.

Crimson Cauldron panicked because he spent his whole life perfecting the flame inside his cauldron. He never knew flames could be burned to ashes as well. Normally, they contested each other, which was a battle of endurance and intensity.

He played with fire since birth yet this was the first time he saw a flame completely superior to his own.

"This is a thing?" Big shots and ancestors were speechless to see the scattering ashes.

"Fire can turn to ashes?" The new emperor, Bronze-blade, murmured in a daze.

"First time seeing this." Black Witch Monarch laughed.

Once Li Qiye got rid of the ocean of lava, the temperature reduced dramatically. The area around him and various affinities became frozen in ice.

"Absolute Frost Domain!" Coldblade's expression soured.

This was Frost Emperor's supreme dao, granting the ability to lord over anything trapped inside.

Thus, the area disappeared, becoming illusory as if non-existent. Dao, laws, powers, and treasures - all were severed from existence.

The target would lose all senses, unaware of how the emperor took control.

Bronze-blade and Coldblade became alarmed, the same with the youths. This was their first time seeing an ability nullifying and returning everything to zero. It wasn't an offensive or killing method but a direct way to remove the opponent.

"Buzz." A fire hand reached out from the affected area, somehow popping out of the void and grasping her throat.

She had disappeared previously and no one could sense her. However, the hand found her and brought her back for all to see.

She looked helpless despite being a powerful emperor within her domain. Her neck turned red with smoke; her skin burned to a crisp.

"Ahh!" She couldn't help but scream; her face twisted in agony and lost its beauty.

The domain melted next, revealing Li Qiye with more flames from the tree. He gained a fiery aura while being in total control.

She looked like an insect before perplexed spectators. They had no explanation for her defeat.

"Stop!" Crimson Cauldron roared and threw his cauldron. It grew in size along the way, aiming to smash Li Qiye.
